# NOTE: AWS, Slack, and Stripe example values are deliberately NOT included
# here as static contiguous strings — GitHub's own push-protection secret

# three types are instead assembled at test time from split fragments in
# secret_fragments.py (never written contiguously to this repo's git
# history) and appended to this file's contents in-memory by
# tests/conftest.py's `positive_text` fixture before scanning.
